['Der Holzring GmbH '].company_description: Der Holzring GmbH operates in the wood products and panels industry, offering a range of products including furniture, hardwood, pallets, roundwood, sawn timber, and softwood.

['Georg von Holtzbrinck GmbH & Co. KG '].company_description: Georg von Holtzbrinck GmbH & Co. KG is a German publishing company that operates in the media industry. The company owns various publishing houses and media brands, including Die Zeit, Gruner + Jahr, and Böhlau Verlag.
